factor_configuration.adjustment_scale_rationale: six points is below the production seven-point partial-data penalty and common eight-to-ten-point components, but can reorder close peers
factor_configuration.factor_composite: mean centered percentile across participating metrics
factor_configuration.metric_percentile: average-tied ascending rank transformed so lower multiple is better
ranking_order: shared production selector with country minima

hypothesis: Within the same long-term gate tier, companies that are relatively cheaper than other companies available at the same decision time will subsequently outperform otherwise similarly ranked companies.

selection_configuration.full_ranking: constrained selection first, then remaining base-ranked members
selection_configuration.ordering: gate (long-term), score descending, ticker ascending, stable input order
selection_configuration.weighting: equal decision-time weights; missing returns do not renormalize
